messages:
From: Jane Patel <jane.patel@marigoldhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marigold Product Ops <product-ops@marigoldhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff + MAP request — Marigold launch (Sept)

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about faster inference for our triage workflows. We want to lock an initial mutual action plan so engineering and product ops can coordinate timelines. High level asks from our side:

- Go-live target: 2026-11-15 (soft launch with 10% traffic)
- Must-haves: embeddings + generation API calls with < 200ms P95 on short queries
- Compliance/retention: need clear guidance on event logs retention and isolation for PHI-adjacent data

Can you send a MAP draft that maps milestones, owners, and a recommended sprint cadence? If you can include obvious risk lanes (infra, security approval, integration hooks) that would help our PM.

Attaching a one-pager of our internal milestones for context.

Best,
Jane
Jane Patel
VP Product, Marigold Health

Subject: Re: Kickoff + MAP request — Marigold launch (Sept)

Thanks Jane — great alignment on target. I attached a working MAP (Excel) that breaks down milestones into three two-week sprints and assigns primary/backup owners. Quick summary here:

Sprint 1 (09/06–09/19): authentication + network connectivity (owners: Ben / Monica)
Sprint 2 (09/20–10/03): model integration, quantization profile selection, perf baseline (owners: Ben / Karthik)
Sprint 3 (10/04–10/17): validation, canary plan, runbook & rollback (owners: Monica / Ava)

Major risks: security sign-off cadence (expected 2–3 weeks), long-tail infra tweaks if our prefix caching needs custom rules. Suggested mitigations in the MAP: early security kickoff (week of 09/06), weekly SRE sync, and a contingency buffer of one sprint before your soft launch.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the owners on your side for network and SRE contact.
2) We schedule a 30-min MAP walkthrough Tues 09/07 or Wed 09/08 — I can do 10–11am PT both days.
3) We freeze the RACI by 09/10 so engineering can book capacity.

Attachment: Marigold_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (xls, 120KB)

Thanks — cc'ing Ben, Monica, and Karthik to pick up owners and risks.

—

Ava — quick internal update after reviewing Jane's targets and our draft MAP: I've sketched sprint-level tasks and pushed a small RACI PDF to the shared Drive link. Key changes from the v0.9 draft:

- Moved security kickoff to 09/07 (internal intake) so artifacts are available for Marigold's review by 09/13.
- Added an SRE preflight task (09/08–09/10) to validate network egress rules and KMS policy. Owner: Monica (primary), Karthik (backup).
- Model perf baseline window set for 09/22–09/26 (Ben primary).

I recommend we reserve a single warm GPU for two days during the baseline window to catch quantization regressions early. I'll block time on infra and ping SRE to confirm.
